name: telegram.stock_digest

description.en: The weekly loss digest (W-STOCK P4): a count session that closes at least one tracked window, at most once in 6.5 days (a `digest` note on the stock log remembers), owes `stock.digest` -- the top 5 unexplained losses, valued -- to every venue group that chose it, rendered in each group's language by the router (notify/route.rs fan_out -> render::event). Read back through the Bot API needs a QA bot and group the box does not hold.
description.uk: Щотижневий дайджест непояснених втрат у Telegram-групи закладу, мовою кожної групи.

producer.what: owe(): the data and its note, from the count's turn (stock/turn.rs run)

consumer.what: HAND-BACK: render::event needs the arm "stock.digest" => digest::text(d, lang); events.rs needs the catalogue row; telegram-words.js the label. line 0 = absent until main applies the hand-back

auth.where: MISSING: operator creates a TEST bot + group (same ask as W-LIVE row 5)

probe: node tools/live-proof/probes/stock-avt.mjs (main runs it on qa-durres after deploy)
